ui._comment: English source. Keys never change; translate the values. {name} placeholders are filled in by the app; keep them. Keys ending in _html may contain simple HTML tags such as <em>.
ui.brand.tagline: A deduction card game for scientists. Find the flaw hidden in the manuscript before your review rounds run out.
ui.lang.label: Language
ui.footer: Major Revisions v{version}, a SMART-Lab Science Game Kit game. Every study is fictional; every flaw, reference and guideline item is real.
ui.home.title_html: Every manuscript hides a flaw. Find it.
ui.home.lede: Five face-down cards, one or two of them flawed. Ask the right reviewer questions, name the flawed card and give the verdict an editor would.
ui.home.play.title: Review a manuscript
ui.home.play.text: The computer deals a fictional study as five cards and answers your requests truthfully. Five requests, then your report.
ui.home.decks.text: Every Study, Request, Verdict and Manuscript card, with the flaws, why they matter and the guideline item that catches each one.
ui.quick.title: Would this answer worry you?
ui.quick.text: A reviewer asked for something. Read the authors' answer and decide.
ui.tip.studies: Fictional studies, each written up as five manuscript cards and reported with a real guideline such as CONSORT or PRISMA.
ui.tip.requests: What a reviewer can ask the authors for. Each one costs a review round and points to the guideline item that requires it.
ui.tip.verdicts: Accept, minor revisions, major revisions or reject: the call an editor makes from your report.
ui.tip.manuscripts: The five parts of a study, each in a sound and a flawed version. Dealt face down; requests reveal their answers.
ui.tip.flaws: Real, documented flaws, each linked to the paper that describes it.
ui.tip.combos: Different flawed manuscripts the app can deal: every study with one or two of its cards flawed.
ui.play.expert: Expert: the manuscript may be sound
ui.play.seed_title: The same number always deals the same manuscript. Share the link to review it together.
ui.play.manuscript_hint: Five cards, face down. One or two carry a planted flaw. Tap a card to read it full size.
ui.play.manuscript_hint_expert: Five cards, face down. Up to two carry a planted flaw, or none at all. Tap a card to read it full size.
ui.play.hand_hint: Tap a request to read it, then send it. The authors must answer truthfully, on the card it is about.
ui.play.log_empty: No requests yet. Read the claim and the five cards, then ask about the part you trust least.
ui.play.na: Not applicable: nothing in this study answers that. The round is spent.
ui.play.out: No requests left. Time to write your report.
ui.play.step1: The claim, and what each card says was done.
ui.play.step2: Each request reveals one answer on one card and costs a round.
ui.play.step3: Mark the flawed card or cards, then give a verdict.
ui.play.scoring: Scoring: flaw found +{found} · sound card marked {wrong} · right verdict +{verdict} · each unused request +{unused}, if your report is fully right
ui.report.title: Your report
ui.report.mark: Tap each card you think is flawed (tap again to unmark).
ui.report.verdict_hint: Tap a verdict card to read it, then give it.
ui.result.clean_right: 🎉 Rightly accepted: this one was sound.
ui.result.verdict_rule: The verdict follows the worst flaw: reject beats major beats minor; no flaw, accept.
ui.result.none_planted: Nothing was planted: every card was sound.
ui.result.author: At the table, the Author would score {n} for flaws that got through.
ui.ref.title: Key reference: {cite}
ui.card.read_only: Read out only what is asked
ui.card.step1: The Author picks a Study and plants one or two flawed cards among the five.
ui.card.step2: The Author reads the claim and every card's As-submitted line.
ui.card.step3: On your turn, play a Request, or file a report on one card.
ui.card.step4: The Author reads aloud only the answer to that request.
ui.card.step5: When rounds run out, every reviewer gives a verdict. Reveal all.
ui.card.sc_unused: Each round left when you find it
ui.print.title: {game}: print and play
ui.print.intro: {tagline} Version {version}. {total} cards in standard poker size (63 × 88 mm), 9 per A4 page.
ui.print.printing_html: Print at 100% on A4 with background graphics on. For double-sided cards, print backs.html on the reverse.
ui.print.answers_html: The Author's crib sheet is the flaw key: every planted flaw, its verdict, the request and guideline item that catch it, and why it matters.
ui.print.key_intro: Each study's planted flaws, the verdict each one earns, and the request that catches it with its reporting-guideline item. A manuscript's verdict is that of its worst flaw.

art._comment: Labels drawn inside card pictures. Translate the values; keep them short.
